name: vexmarch
description: Vexmarch - a real-time grand strategy game (web + Android wrapper)

scripts.test: node tools/test.js && node tools/test_war.js && node tools/test_officers.js && node tools/test_fog.js && node tools/test_hazards.js && node tools/test_ai.js && node tools/test_layout.js && node tools/test_crowd.js && node tools/test_story.js && node tools/test_diplo.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run www && ([ -d android ] || npx cap add android) && node tools/android_patch.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
